text.offer: The Duke and the Princess squabble while the dead walk out of Brax. Somebody has to deal with it, and it might as well be us - the people will remember who stood up. There's a ghost in the Cragged Mountains, Tendrath, who knows the way into that buried city. Go and talk to him.
text.progress: Tendrath haunts the Cragged Mountains, outside the ancient place where Brax lies buried.
text.complete: Jonas D'Accor's people, fighting the dead? Perhaps there is hope for the living after all.

steps.objective: Find Tendrath in the Cragged Mountains
